payload.title: Which change to the run practice keeps a review from being cut off by the budget or dragged out by small fixes?
payload.body: Each rival is a change to hyp-goal-run or to the stop clause hyp prompt prints, and each names its cut: the store as of one Result, replayed with hyp sandbox create --store --cut. The control arm (unchanged hyp-goal-run) runs at the same cut and is not a Hypothesis. The Goal's lines are the cases. Cuts: run 1 after R-8JQPWG (actor claude-g113-1, 1 Result left of 5); run 2 after R-3YJ7T2 (actor claude-g113-2, 1 left of 5); run 3 after R-JHBCWS (actor claude-g113-3, 4 left of 5); final after R-BSWFXG (04142f3 is the candidate, its review limit open).

why: The contested question of issue #141; the owner chose one question for all six rivals.

payload.title: H-name-at-stop: the stop checkpoint names each candidate commit that has no review
payload.body: Keep the practice. At the stop, the checkpoint names each candidate commit without a review Result. Cuts: run 1 after R-8JQPWG and run 2 after R-3YJ7T2. Expected by the owner: line 1 contradicts it alone, since naming is not a review; it stays a part of any combination. No preset verdict.

why: A rival of issue #141, listed by the owner; tested by replay from its cut.

payload.title: H-reserve-last: with one Result left, review the current candidate instead of committing another fix
payload.body: When one Result remains, the runner reviews the current candidate instead of committing another fix, and stops with the review's limits recorded. A case whose check already passes closes as a limit, not with a new commit. Cuts: run 1 after R-8JQPWG and run 2 after R-3YJ7T2.

why: A rival of issue #141, listed by the owner; tested by replay from its cut.

payload.title: H-one-experiment: a candidate's review is part of its gate Experiment
payload.body: One Experiment carries the gate verdicts and the review, and one Result carries the test verdicts and the review's limits, so a candidate costs one Result again. hyp-goal-run states how a review is recorded and that it counts as part of the gate. Cuts: run 1 after R-8JQPWG and run 2 after R-3YJ7T2.

why: A rival of issue #141, listed by the owner; tested by replay from its cut.

payload.title: H-raise-budget: the default of --experiments rises to 7
payload.body: The stop clause hyp prompt prints defaults to 7 Results under the actor, to fit a gate and a review per candidate. The trial prompt uses --experiments 7. Cuts: run 1 after R-8JQPWG and run 2 after R-3YJ7T2.

why: A rival of issue #141, listed by the owner; tested by replay from its cut.

payload.title: H-probe-closes: a case the run's own probe passes is closed in the review's Result, not recorded as a limit
payload.body: A case that the run's own probe runs and passes on the candidate is closed in the review Result, since a check ran it. A limit stays for a case no check ran or one the candidate fails. Cut: run 3 after R-JHBCWS, where N1 closes on 3cfd08d and no fix commit follows.

why: A rival of issue #141, listed by the owner; tested by replay from its cut.

payload.title: H-whole-candidate: the review before the select reads the cumulative diff from the Goal's base
payload.body: The review before the select reads the cumulative diff from the Goal's base to the candidate, not the latest increment. Cut: final, after R-BSWFXG, with 04142f3 as the candidate. The owner expects it to lose on cost; no preset verdict.

why: A rival of issue #141, listed by the owner; tested by replay from its cut.
The issue this discovery Goal serves.

payload.summary: Grill done: 2 lines written by owner-standin. Q-RC1DHJ holds six rivals (H-name-at-stop, H-reserve-last, H-one-experiment, H-raise-budget, H-probe-closes, H-whole-candidate), each with its cut named; no candidate is tied to a subject yet. Out-of-Goal: the build Goal (hyp-goal-run review practice, the stop clause, docs/how-hyp-improves-itself.md line 29) is added by the owner after the selects.
